purpose: Reproducibility artifact requested in PR #99 review: real Vaihingen N=100 sampled points and the resulting normalized_spread value under the CURRENT (PR #99, median-based) formula, so the re-derived MIN_NORMALIZED_SPREAD threshold can be independently recomputed.
scope_note: Vaihingen controls only -- no real Mount Adams DEM data exists on this machine. See DW_ISSUE91_TRACK_B_GATE_VALIDATION_N100/RESULTS.json for Mount Adams' real spread values under the OLD (pre-#99) formula.
current_formula_note: normalized_spread() = MEDIAN nearest-neighbour distance / expected nearest-neighbour distance for N uniformly-distributed points over the AOI area (~0.5*sqrt(area/N)). See src/preflight.py's normalized_spread() docstring and MIN_NORMALIZED_SPREAD's comment for the full derivation.
